title: Accessibility Basics
description: WCAG-oriented checklist for keyboard navigation, contrast, and assistive technology compatibility.

steps.title: Test Keyboard Navigation
steps.instructions: Tab through homepage, menu, modals, and forms without a mouse. Ensure focus order is logical and focus rings are visible.

steps.title: Check Color Contrast
steps.instructions: Verify body text, buttons, and links meet WCAG AA contrast ratios (4.5:1 for normal text). Fix low-contrast hero overlays.

steps.title: Audit Image Alt Text
steps.instructions: Review media library and key pages. Decorative images should have empty alt; informative images need descriptive alt text.

steps.title: Verify Form Labels
steps.instructions: Every input must have a visible label or aria-label. Error messages should be announced and associated with fields.

steps.title: Fix Heading Hierarchy
steps.instructions: Ensure one H1 per page and headings do not skip levels (H2 → H4). Page builders often need manual cleanup.

steps.title: Add Skip to Content Link
steps.instructions: Confirm the theme provides a skip link to main content. If missing, add one visible on keyboard focus.

steps.title: Run Automated A11y Scan
steps.instructions: Scan with axe DevTools, WAVE, or Lighthouse accessibility audit. Triage critical issues before client handoff.
